title: Infinite transitivity of tame groups of automorphisms of affine spaces
summary: For positive integers $n$ and $m$, we study the actions of the groups of tame automorphisms of the $n$-dimensional affine spaces over finite fields on ordered subsets of $m$ points. Our primary interest lies in constructing tame automorphisms that take one ordered sequence to another and in proving upper and lower bounds on the maximal complexity of such automorphisms. Our preferred measure of complexity of an automorphism is the maximum of the degrees of the polynomials that define it and its inverse.
